name: chiangmai-timelapse
description: Motion-graphics hybrid timelapse of Chiang Mai history (9:16, Thai)

scripts.bench: node scripts/node_guard.mjs && remotion benchmark src/index.ts Chachoengsao --frames=0-299 --runs=2 --concurrencies=2,4,6,8 --gl=angle --muted
scripts.audio:korat: node scripts/export_timeline.mjs src/cities/korat/timeline.ts out/timeline_korat.json && python3 scripts/soundtrack_korat.py
scripts.render:korat: node scripts/check_story.mjs korat && remotion render Korat out/korat.mp4 --gl=angle --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=256k
scripts.audio:ayutthaya: node scripts/export_timeline.mjs src/cities/ayutthaya/timeline.ts out/timeline_ayutthaya.json && python3 scripts/soundtrack_ayutthaya.py
scripts.render:ayutthaya: node scripts/check_story.mjs ayutthaya && remotion render Ayutthaya out/ayutthaya.mp4 --gl=angle --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=256k
scripts.audio:sukhothai: node scripts/export_timeline.mjs src/cities/sukhothai/timeline.ts out/timeline_sukhothai.json && python3 scripts/soundtrack_sukhothai.py
scripts.render:sukhothai: node scripts/check_story.mjs sukhothai && remotion render Sukhothai out/sukhothai.mp4 --gl=angle --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=256k
scripts.render:phitsanulok: node scripts/check_story.mjs phitsanulok && remotion render Phitsanulok out/phitsanulok.mp4 --gl=angle --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=256k
scripts.audio:phitsanulok: node scripts/export_timeline.mjs src/cities/phitsanulok/timeline.ts out/timeline_phitsanulok.json && python3 scripts/soundtrack_phitsanulok.py
scripts.render:chachoengsao: node scripts/check_story.mjs chachoengsao && remotion render Chachoengsao out/chachoengsao.mp4 --gl=angle --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=256k
scripts.audio:chachoengsao: node scripts/export_timeline.mjs src/cities/chachoengsao/timeline.ts out/timeline_chachoengsao.json && python3 scripts/soundtrack_chachoengsao.py
